abstract: Bone marrow fibrosis in myeloproliferative neoplasms is driven by interactions between hematopoietic and stromal cells, yet the multicellular organization underlying disease progression remains poorly understood. In Cell Press Blue, Gleitz et al. combine physical cell-cell interaction profiling, computational modeling, and functional validation to identify an SPP1-centered niche linking inflammation and stromal remodeling, thus highlighting how cellular communication shapes the fibrotic microenvironment.
